data.summary: Formal natural-language contract adopted for next round: 1. Each fisher commits to a conservative harvest target of no more than 4 tons when the lake is at or below 30 tons, and no more than 6 tons when the lake is above 30 tons. 2. If any fisher observes the lake falling below 15 tons at the start of a month, all fishers agree to reduce their next-month target by 1 ton from their prior target, with a floor of 0. 3. If the lake falls below 10 tons at any point, all fishers immediately switch to recovery mode of 0 to 2 tons each until the lake rises back above 20 tons. 4. We agree to share our intended harvest targets openly each month before fishing, and to keep our actual harvests as close as possible to those targets. 5. The group’s priority is long-term sustainability and keeping the lake safely above the collapse threshold of 5 tons. 6. This constitution is voluntary and relies on mutual restraint, but we commit to treating repeated overharvesting as a breach of trust and responding by lowering our own targets to protect the lake.

<constitution>
1. Each fisher commits to a conservative harvest target of no more than 4 tons when the lake is at or below 30 tons, and no more than 6 tons when the lake is above 30 tons.
2. If any fisher observes the lake falling below 15 tons at the start of a month, all fishers agree to reduce their next-month target by 1 ton from their prior target, with a floor of 0.
3. If the lake falls below 10 tons at any point, all fishers immediately switch to a recovery mode of 0 to 2 tons each until the lake rises back above 20 tons.
4. We agree to share our intended harvest targets openly each month before fishing, and to keep our actual harvests as close as possible to those targets.
5. The group’s priority is long-term sustainability and keeping the lake safely above the collapse threshold of 5 tons.
6. This constitution is voluntary and relies on mutual restraint, but we commit to treating repeated overharvesting as a breach of trust and responding by lowering our own targets to protect the lake.
</constitution>
